below_buffer_on.description: The first day whose balance closes below the buffer line; absent when none does, or there is no line.

lowest.description: The lowest balance at a day's end, today's included.

movements.description: Every expected movement in the days, by day.

not_included.description: What the projection does not hold yet, so its lowest point is never taken as complete: pay runs and CPF, GST returns and corporate tax until their changes, and any input it could not read.

opening.description: The money accounts' balance today, each valued at today's rate.

today.description: The organisation's today, the projection's first day.

weekly.description: The first 13 weeks from today, when the projection runs that far (91 days or more).
